bullets.text: Streamlined Container Management - **VS Code** integrates **Copilot** for easier container management, enhancing developer productivity.
Smart Holiday Shopping - **Copilot** in **Edge** offers cashback and price tracking features for a seamless shopping experience.
Enhanced Gaming Experience - **Xbox** full screen gaming is now available for **Windows 11** handhelds, improving gameplay.
Web Install API Testing - **Microsoft Edge** introduces the **Web Install API** for easier web app installations.
AI-Driven Security Operations - **Microsoft Defender Experts** leverage AI to enhance SOC efficiency and threat detection.
